backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining user profiles, stats, availability, chat messages, and several availability query helpers with access‑control enforcement.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented leaderboard UI changes, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of many frontend files for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light and dark modes, including color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entrypoint mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app router and authentication gate handling identity, profile setup, and layout composition.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a user without admin rights attempts to access restricted pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen with background image, branding, and Internet Identity sign‑in button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple component rendering the app logo from branding config.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Shows a group chat UI, loads recent messages, handles sending messages, and manages scrolling and message visibility.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with top bar, navigation, content container, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Renders navigation buttons and conditionally shows an admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Displays the app header with logo, theme toggle, and user avatar menu including logout.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Allows users to view and edit their profile name and picture with upload and validation support.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Shows the caller’s leaderboard rank or a loading placeholder.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Displays the caller’s match history with wins and losses, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter their name and save their profile.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Applies a fixed low-opacity court background behind all content.
Shows a user avatar with initials fallback and a display name, with size options.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor, reloading it on identity changes and invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks for fetching and updating the caller’s user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides react-query hooks to fetch the caller's user role and admin status using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth context, providing identity state, login, logout, and status handling via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines various react-query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability data, leaderboard info, and match history from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme toggling and persists the setting in local storage.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Fetches user display names and avatar info for principals, returning directory maps with fallbacks for missing profiles.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles with custom CSS variables for theming, including light and dark mode settings.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports static branding constants including app name and logo metadata.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for converting dates to IDs, formatting dates/times, building month grids, and checking day equality.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React rendering, wrapping the app with query client and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page for adding or editing availability, handling time selection, notes, and saving via mutation before navigation.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin panel listing users and their availabilities with delete actions and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Displays a month grid with availability indicators and controls for navigating months.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page wrapper that shows the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows all availabilities for a specific day with options to edit or delete the caller’s entry.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays leaderboard standings and lets the caller record or remove daily wins and losses.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile overview showing user info, leaderboard rank, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utilities for converting files to Uint8Array and generating initials from names.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Utility functions for generating time options, formatting times, and parsing time strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL and hash parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing stored or hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, breakpoints, animations, and loads typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Stores the project's current state and requirements, focused on updating the leaderboard to remove score and restore win percentage and streak using all‑time data.
